hook: Mary fasted before Christ was born.

verse.translation: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.”

story: The angel Gabriel told Mary she would conceive and give birth to a son, and that He would be called the Son of God. She answered, “Behold, the servant of the Lord.”
The church teaches that Mary then asked: I have conceived the God that heaven and earth cannot contain, so what shall I do to give birth to Him? And she fasted before His birth.
So this fast has one more name: Tsome Mariam, Mary's fast. With the others, that makes Nebiyat, Adam, Filipos, Hawariat, Mariam, Sibket and Lidet.
meaning: Mary prepared for Christ's birth with fasting and prayer. Each year, the church invites us to prepare the same way.
